frequency_question: How often do federal educational agency recognition termination proceedings result in a final revocation order within a tight multi-year window of visible advance signals?
membership_rule: Includes any formal Department of Education review of a national accreditor resulting in an initial staff recommendation or proceeding for withdrawal of recognition; excludes routine renewals without adverse findings.

cases.name: ABA review cycles and conditional approvals

provenance_note: 4 cases named, 12 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (3.0x)
coverage_note: 12 major contested review processes identified; approximately 2 resulted in final revocation orders.
known_gaps: Lower-level advisory committee recommendations that did not reach final departmental secretary revocation are filtered out.
skeleton: Formal administrative recognition review cycles for major institutional/professional accreditors since 1994
multiplier: 2 hits out of roughly 12 major contested review processes where formal termination was actively signaled or pursued
validity_reason: Administrative procedures governed by the Higher Education Act and federal regulations change slowly across multiple presidential administrations.
